name: Buran translation controller block
view: the translation controller block beside the commander's seat from behind, as the commander sees it: the short handle with its knob on top of the controller block on the side console; pushed along its three axes to translate the orbiter
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the controller block reconstructed from the public Buran orbiter descriptions (buran.ru cockpit overview, Wikipedia) and public museum photos of the cabin looked at for proportions; the handle's exact shape is not confirmed. Not traced from a photo.
